Vue FormBuilder - Embed Demo

How to test the embed functionality:

1. Visit the main form builder at http://localhost:5173/
2. Create a form by adding some fields
3. Click the "Embed" button in the sidebar
4. Enter a submission endpoint URL (you can use a service like httpbin.org for testing)
5. Copy the generated embed code
6. Paste it into the sections below to test

iFrame Embed Example

This is how an iframe embed would look on your website:

<iframe src="http://localhost:5173/embed/[FORM_ID]?endpoint=[ENDPOINT_URL]" width="100%" height="auto" frameborder="0" style="border: none; min-height: 400px;" title="Form"> </iframe>

Replace the iframe code above with your generated embed code to see the form here.

JavaScript Widget Example

This is how a JavaScript widget embed would look:

<div id="form-[FORM_ID]"></div> <script> (function() { var iframe = document.createElement('iframe'); iframe.src = 'http://localhost:5173/embed/[FORM_ID]?endpoint=[ENDPOINT_URL]'; iframe.width = '100%'; iframe.height = 'auto'; iframe.frameBorder = '0'; iframe.style.border = 'none'; iframe.style.minHeight = '400px'; document.getElementById('form-[FORM_ID]').appendChild(iframe); })(); </script>

Replace the script above with your generated embed code to see the form here.

Direct HTML Example

This is how a direct HTML embed would look:

<form action="[ENDPOINT_URL]" method="POST" class="embedded-form"> <!-- Form fields will be generated here --> </form> <style> .embedded-form { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; } .form-group { margin-bottom: 1rem; } /* Additional styles... */ </style>

Replace the HTML above with your generated embed code to see the form here.

Testing Endpoints

You can use these endpoints for testing form submissions:

  • httpbin.org: https://httpbin.org/post - Shows you exactly what was submitted
  • Webhook.site: Visit webhook.site to get a unique URL for testing
  • RequestBin: Visit requestbin.com for another testing option

Features Included

  • ✅ Multiple embed types (iframe, JavaScript, direct HTML)
  • ✅ Customizable dimensions and styling
  • ✅ User-configurable submission endpoints
  • ✅ Form data persistence with unique IDs
  • ✅ Responsive design for mobile and desktop
  • ✅ Copy-to-clipboard functionality
  • ✅ Cross-domain compatibility
  • ✅ Success/error handling for form submissions
